query:
SELECT w.id AS worker_id, w.employee_code, w.name,
       j.id AS job_id, j.status, t.cira_label, jt.qty
FROM workers w
JOIN jobs j       ON j.worker_id = w.id
                 AND j.job_date = CURRENT_DATE
                 AND j.status IN ('assigned','out')
JOIN job_tools jt ON jt.job_id = j.id
JOIN tools t      ON t.id = jt.tool_id AND t.active
WHERE w.face_label = $1 AND w.active
ORDER BY j.id, t.id;

query:
WITH w AS (
  SELECT id FROM workers WHERE employee_code = $2
), ins AS (
  INSERT INTO rounds(round_id, worker_id, job_id, direction, complete)
  SELECT $1, (SELECT id FROM w), $3, $4, $5
  ON CONFLICT (round_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING round_id
), items AS (
  INSERT INTO round_items(round_id, tool_id, need, got)
  SELECT $1, t.id,
         COALESCE((SELECT qty FROM job_tools WHERE job_id = $3 AND tool_id = t.id), 0),
         (x->>'qty')::int
  FROM ins, jsonb_array_elements($6::jsonb) AS x
  JOIN tools t ON t.cira_label = x->>'label'
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
  RETURNING 1
)
UPDATE jobs
SET status = CASE status WHEN 'assigned' THEN 'out' ELSE 'returned' END
WHERE id = $3 AND $5 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ins);
